visualGrammar.positioning: Dark executive consulting deck for technical roadshows, investor updates, and dense strategic narratives.
layoutPrinciples: Use a dark canvas with disciplined top and bottom chrome.
Anchor each page with one dominant headline or KPI cluster before secondary evidence.
Keep dense pages structured with panels, tables, and consistent gutters.
Prefer native PPTX cards, rules, charts, and tables over decorative imagery.
signatureElements: copper or coral accents on deep navy backgrounds
KPI row cards with strong numeric hierarchy
dark evidence panels with thin rules and small source notes
benchmark tables, conversion flows, roadmap steps, and ask pages

typography.body: legible consulting sans body text with restrained line lengths
typography.numeric: oversized tabular numbers paired with short labels

compositionRules: Lead with the decision message, then expose supporting metrics or evidence below.
Use 2-4 visual zones per page; avoid scattering many unrelated mini-cards.
Reserve warm accents for emphasis, not broad fills.
Keep footers and sources quiet but consistently placed.
avoid: decorative illustrations that do not carry data
arbitrary customOps outside DeckKit slide data
long legal copy inside KPI cards

titleZone.headingStyle: Inter semibold, off-white, compact line height
titleZone.accentRule: thin copper rule or small copper label marker

tableRemap.emphasis: use palette.accent only for winning cells, deltas, or callout rows
rules: Keep table geometry and row count from the source deck.
Use tight Inter body text and muted secondary labels for sources or units.
Prefer thin internal rules over heavy boxed cells.

chartRemap.structure: compact data-first chart on dark surface panel
rules: Keep native chart data and chart type unchanged unless the source is non-editable.
Use warm accent only for the key series or highlighted bar.
Keep labels concise and put interpretation in the title zone or callout.

notes: Use the DeckKit-specific fallback profile instead of generic visualGrammar derivation.
Preserve source slides and editable objects; restyle theme colors, fonts, backgrounds, text, shapes, tables, charts, and existing page chrome.

source lines and small consulting-style notes
crisis snapshot metrics, demographic profiles, and priority matrices

typography.body: compact consulting body text optimized for evidence pages

compositionRules: Keep titles specific enough to read as a recommendation or finding.
Use blue structure for hierarchy; keep charts and tables visually quiet.
Place sources and assumptions consistently near the lower edge.

rounded decorative containers without analytical purpose
image-led pages that hide the key finding

knownLimits: Based on all eight Kimsoong customer-loyalty reference pages; Arial / Arial Unicode MS substitute source Arial / Microsoft YaHei without embedding.
2.0 uses numeric percentage records and semantic tones; see intent.md for the explicit field migration.
Cohort lengths and matrix areas are derived editable shapes. Manually changing data or annotations does not synchronize the other; regenerate from content.
Tabler icons are SVG pictures; their individual path nodes are not native shapes. No one-off reference media or logo is bundled.
Source business figures and targets are unverified demonstrations. No entity, conclusion, confidentiality text, target or funding policy is fixed in the skin.
Five-segment rail cohorts need short labels; ledger cells are limited to 80 characters. Narrow Chinese cells may wrap punctuation. Use another registered layout or split content when capacity fails.
Windows, other Office versions, cross-host pixel parity and source-deck refurbishment fidelity were not verified in this migration.
